original_test_intent: Verify ADDDC adds a second bank-VLS region when the existing buddy rank reaches threshold in a different, unprotected bank, while preserving the original bank region and clearing its per-rank CE counter.
original_method: Capture platform settings and the predecessor failed/buddy map; confirm buddy CS0x4/bank1 decodes to DIMM1/rank0/subchannel0 and that bank0 is outside the region; halt, set dev0=0 mask0x3 and inject exactly two CEs at DIMM1 bank0; verify threshold; go once; optionally sample copy_in_progress; verify original region unchanged, correctly mapped second bank region present and rank counter cleared; restore and verify health.
manual_activity: Intel-qualified owner/FAE validates predecessor buddy decode and out-of-region bank choice, controls two CEs/go and recovery while the agent compares ADDDC regions and counters.
required_inputs: GNR/BIOS/BMC/OS, DIMM/chip-select topology and POR disposition
Initial failed/buddy VLS map, CS0x4 decode and proof bank0 is outside bank1 region
Expected second bank-region failed/buddy mapping and counter-clear fields
SMM timeout, serial/OOB recovery and restoration plan
safety_requirements: Dedicated workload-free SUT with live serial/OOB
Reject unverified buddy decode, changed initial region or dirty baseline
Exactly two approved bank0 CEs; do not repeat for copy timing
Stop on loss of first region, absent/wrong second region, counter mismatch or hang
Preserve topology evidence and restore/recover under owner control
agent_execution_scope: Validate predecessor map and outside-region target
Capture exactly two injections, threshold and post-SMM state

Do not choose target, inject/retry/recover independently or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Approve chip-select/bank relation and region decoder

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Reliability row177 Wistron-System RAS-00134-V001: approve GNR/BIOS/BMC/OS, DIMM/POR topology, CScripts version/hash/license and SMI/threshold2/ADDDC mappings; provide the initial failed/buddy region, prove chip-select0x4 bank1 decodes to DIMM1/rank0/subchannel0 and bank0 is outside that region, define threshold, preserved-first/expected-second-region and counter-clear oracle, SMM timeout and OOB no-retry recovery/restoration.

review_improvement: Separates this outside-region buddy case from reverse sparing, binds it to a verified chip-select/bank map and requires the complete durable VLS result.
independent_technical_reasoning: The target remains on the buddy rank but moves away from the bank currently serving as the spare region. Therefore BIOS need not reverse the existing pairing; it should allocate another bank region and retain the first. This outcome can only be demonstrated by before/after region tables tied to the decoded bank0 target. Counter clearing shows SMM consumed the new threshold, whereas copy_in_progress is a transient observation and generic logs reveal none of the mapping policy.
